positions.title: Guardian - Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Spearheaded the upgrade of Guardian for robust CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) detection in Gemini training datasets.
Led the integration with Google's Ares Child Safety API, leveraging Blobstore and Flume for superior hash matching, automated reporting to NCMEC, and legal compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Software Design

positions.title: Child Safety - Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of engineers for detecting Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) on Google products, doing Account Enforcement and reporting to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC).

positions.title: Assistant - Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and implemented Custom Intents for Google Assistant which allows developers to add their own custom queries for their mobile apps. Partners at Launch included Nike, Discord, Mint, Walmart.
Also helped with the successful launches of Restaurant Reservations and Search Punts on Smart Displays.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ad Platforms
Owner of the Reporting Service API for Search Ads Core Services.
Launched the new Custom Report Builder which allows users to create custom reports with any dimensions and metrics they want, schedule when they want to receive them and then be able to download them as CSV’s. 
Doubled number of reports supported for our existing REST API for both internal and external users.
Provided reporting support for numerous new Search Ads features including global expansion, basic campaigns, creative sets, deleted assets, attribution, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle SQL Developer · Java · Software Design · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Interim Team Lead of four engineers working on Merchant Tablet and Consumer Tablet products.
Won 1st prize in Summer 2016 company hackathon, with a team of two others, for implementing a public company API.
Won 2nd prize in Fall 2014 company hackathon for an employee directory which became the company’s internal directory.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Django · Android Development · Software Design · PostgreSQL · AngularJS · JavaScript

positions.title: Owner and President
positions.description:
Web application consulting, mostly on the ATG platform.

Past clients have included Natura, Collective Brands, Ulta, Facebook, USPS, Laura Mercier, Cineplex, Upromise, Perry Ellis, Original Penguin, HomePortfolio, A&E Television, Casual Male, P&G, ATG, NFL, Bell Canada, Robin Miller.

Typically I work on the store website and am responsible for different parts of checkout, catalog, profile, inventory, promotions, gift certificates, coupons, wish lists, fulfillment, etc. Also have been part of projects for upgrading the ATG installation, migrating to a multi-site ATG solution, integrating with various back end services, etc. Sometimes I do work with BCC, ATG Search, Merchandising, Portal, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · Java · Web Applications · ATG Dynamo · JavaScript · ATG Commerce · Consulting

projects.title: Fuel Pup iOS App
projects.description:
Swift application for logging fuel mileage for ICE cars.

Uses image recognition to read the cost and gallons from the fuel pump and the miles from the odometer.

Uses Firebase for Authentication and Cloud Storage.
